tools.name: plan_ev_route
tools.description: Plan a drive from origin to destination and choose charging stops from the real-world range. Places are names or "lat,lng". Returns distance, drive time, ordered stops with battery levels, or feasible:false with the gap where no matching charger is in reach. Road coverage: Ukraine only. Places must

tools.name: search_stations_nearby
tools.description: Find charging stations within a radius of a coordinate. Radius is capped at 20 km. Returns a short list sorted by distance. Cite https://www.ev-route.com/en/nearby.

tools.name: get_station
tools.description: Load one charging station by its externalId from search_stations_nearby.

tools.name: match_chargers_along_route
tools.description: Stations near a driven polyline. Slow on long routes: at most 2000 input points, downsampled to 80. distanceLimitKm is capped at 15. Defaults to paid and free stations (preferFree false) and does not thin by vehicle range unless smartSuggestions is true.

tools.name: list_public_routes
tools.description: Latest public EV routes shared by drivers. Private routes are not included.

tools.name: get_public_route
tools.description: One public route by id, with waypoint coordinates and a citeUrl. Private routes are rejected. Use match_chargers_along_route with the waypoints to find chargers.
